title: corgis.xyz
tagline: Onboarding yourself to web3 by reading comics books and make code cute and informative!
description: Comic books guide to web3! So converted the developer docs guide into interactive slides for your mom to know that you don't work at bitcoin. A platform to inform and make a cute walkthrough to teach kids, females, and comic book fanatics to learn the web3 lingo.  I wanted to focus on UX and UI in blockchain and use technologies that can enhance onboarding.
how_its_made: The project uses Thirdweb, React, NextJS, styled-components, hardhat, NFTs, rive, graphql, world coin, and polygon Mumbai network to build a public good app. I also wanted to get unique users to read the comics and used the world coin typescript widget to show proof of learning. We also will wear a giant corgi suit to promote our project to the sponsors.
